records.title: GTF3C5 p.Glu503_Glu506del
records.dna_only: The repetitive 12-nt deletion predicts loss of four glutamates, but DNA alone cannot establish which low-complexity transcript sequence is expressed.
records.decision_reason: Isovar reconstructs a 29-aa protein context whose deletion junction agrees with the reference-plus-edit translation; independent RNA scans support the exact allele in ONT and short-read data from T1 and T2.
records.interpretation: GTF3C5 is the strongest additional cross-platform indel: 117/128 ONT and 7/12 short-read alternate fragments support T1/T2, while assembly resolves the repetitive protein context used for ranking.
records.limitation: Direct audit counts measure exact allele-spanning fragments and are distinct from the pinned T1 ONT fragments used to assemble the ranked protein.
records.summary_rna: ONT ALT: 117 T1 / 128 T2; short-read ALT: 7 T1 / 12 T2

rna_evidence.source: T1 ONT assembly plus four-product exact-allele audit
rna_evidence.counts_text: assembly corpus: 13 ALT / 29 REF / 5 OTHER; direct audit: ONT 117 T1 + 128 T2, short-read 7 T1 + 12 T2

records.title: TECPR1 p.Thr259fs
records.dna_only: The one-base deletion predicts a frameshift, but DNA alone does not establish how much expressed mutant reading frame is supported.
records.decision_reason: Illumina overlap assembly extends the supported protein from 37 to 49 aa and Vaxrank identifies a target-bearing 25-aa construct.
records.interpretation: This is the strongest short-read assembly example: both translations validate, while assembly adds twelve supported upstream residues and changes the candidate-window pool.
records.limitation: The osteosarc.com page publishes a longer predicted context; this panel ranks only the 49 aa directly reconstructed from the selected RNA evidence.
records.summary_rna: Illumina assembly: 49 aa versus 37 aa without overlap assembly

records.title: GLIS3 p.Ser775fs
records.dna_only: The 8-bp deletion predicts a new reading frame but cannot prove that the resulting transcript and mutant tail are expressed.
records.decision_reason: Illumina RNA reconstructs a validated 43-aa mutant context and Vaxrank selects a target-bearing long peptide.
records.interpretation: RNA agrees with the nominated complex deletion, making GLIS3 a positive reconstruction control rather than a disagreement with Varcode. An independent exact-allele audit found nine T1 short-read alternate fragments.
records.limitation: The website's 80-aa vaccine sequence extends beyond the 43-aa RNA context ranked here and is retained separately in the source record.
records.summary_rna: T1 Illumina: 9 exact-allele fragments; validated 43-aa frameshift context

rna_evidence.counts_text: selected assembly corpus: 10 ALT observations; independent exact-allele audit: 9 T1 short-read fragments

records.title: RNF213 p.Ile1070Ile (del Leu)
records.dna_only: The genomic allele predicts loss of one leucine; RNA is needed to establish expression and its local translated context.
records.decision_reason: Illumina RNA supports the in-frame deletion and Vaxrank selects a target-bearing 25-aa construct.
records.interpretation: The RNA and nominated edit agree, providing a robust complex-indel reconstruction control across the DNA, RNA, protein, and epitope layers. A separate audit found alternate fragments in both technologies and both samples.
records.limitation: The rank is specific to the five assessed patient class-I alleles and default filters.
records.summary_rna: RNA ALT audit: ONT 5/14 and short-read 42/11 in T1/T2

rna_evidence.source: T1 BostonGene assembly plus four-product exact-allele audit
rna_evidence.counts_text: selected assembly corpus: 39 ALT observations / 38 templates; direct audit: ONT 5 T1 + 14 T2, short-read 42 T1 + 11 T2

records.title: DYNC1H1 p.Val314Ile
records.dna_only: The SNV predicts p.Val314Ile, but does not by itself establish expression or the sample-specific transcript context.
records.decision_reason: RNA assembly and non-assembly modes agree on the same 45-aa context; Vaxrank recovers the strong KRFHATISF-centered candidate.
records.interpretation: This is a concordant control. Assembly does not change the sequence, and the selected window overlaps vaccine sequences published on osteosarc.com.
records.limitation: RNA observations in the pinned primary corpus are evidence for reconstruction, not a full-sample abundance estimate.
records.summary_rna: ONT: 48 ALT, 7 OTHER; assembly and no-assembly sequences agree

records.title: DYNC1H1 p.Gln3267His
records.dna_only: The second DYNC1H1 SNV predicts p.Gln3267His but does not establish the expressed sequence context.
records.decision_reason: Illumina assembly adds one supported upstream residue and Vaxrank retains a low-scoring but filter-passing target-bearing construct.
records.interpretation: This locus is distinct from the strong p.Val314Ile result. Its predicted class-I signal is weak, which is visible rather than hidden.
records.limitation: osteosarc.com annotates this locus but does not currently publish a protein sequence context; the displayed sequence is RNA-derived.
records.summary_rna: Illumina: 34 ALT, 0 OTHER; assembly adds one upstream residue

records.title: NAV2 p.Ala1809Val
records.dna_only: The SNV maps to multiple transcript consequences; DNA alone cannot choose the RNA-contributing transcript model.
records.decision_reason: Illumina RNA yields one validated 47-aa sequence compatible with two contributing transcript models and a target-bearing construct.
records.interpretation: The sequence is resolved while isoform identity remains non-unique. Both assembled transcript IDs are preserved instead of reporting one guessed source.
records.limitation: The RNA window ends before reference transcript predictions diverge, so this result does not claim unique isoform resolution.
records.summary_rna: Illumina: 18 ALT; one sequence, two compatible transcript models

records.title: MAP2 compound frameshift haplotype
records.dna_only: The historical isolated 22-bp deletion predicts a different protein. Full evidence instead supports adjacent substitutions plus a 28-nt deletion on one haplotype.
records.decision_reason: Four exact Q20 T1 Illumina reads establish the compound haplotype; its translation passes the evidence gate and is ranked as an explicit assembled antigen.
records.interpretation: The compound protein encodes ...DRAH..., not the listed-only ...DSTQ... or deletion-only ...DLAH... alternatives. The website now publishes the same compound protein context.
records.limitation: This is a transcript-aware reference-plus-compound-edit translation, not a whole-RNA Isovar protein reconstruction; that distinction is retained in the source metadata.
records.summary_rna: T1 Illumina: 4 exact Q20 compound reads; T2 Illumina and ONT corroborate

rna_evidence.counts_text: 4 Q20 T1 ILMN + 2 Q20 T2 ILMN + 1 Q20 T2 ONT compound witnesses

records.title: NTF3 compound p.Lys69Ser haplotype
records.variant_class: RNA correction of isolated SNV effect
records.dna_only: Treating A>G alone predicts Lys-to-Arg. RNA carries the adjacent base change too, so the expressed AG>GT haplotype encodes serine.
records.decision_reason: The explicit compound allele is independently observed in Illumina and ONT RNA, passes the evidence gate, and yields a target-bearing peptide.
records.interpretation: NTF3 is the cleanest RNA-versus-single-edit correction: the amino acid changes because the true local haplotype spans two adjacent bases.
records.limitation: osteosarc.com lists p.Lys69Ser but does not currently publish a protein context; the displayed window comes from the RNA reconstruction.
records.summary_rna: Illumina and ONT reproduce AG>GT; single-edit Lys→Arg is rejected

rna_evidence.counts_text: 4 ALT templates and 4 REF templates in the selected Illumina reconstruction

records.title: CD109 long-read phased alleles
records.dna_only: Two variants 6,181 bp apart cannot be assigned to one expressed molecule from independent DNA calls or site-local short reads.
records.decision_reason: Twenty-one ONT UMI groups and three exact 222-nt Q20 reads phase the alleles, but no target epitope passes the configured class-I filters.
records.interpretation: Long reads change the protein claim by linking two substitutions 207 coding nucleotides apart. Vaxrank retains the negative epitope result without forcing selection.
records.limitation: No 25-mer spans both amino-acid changes; long reads prove molecular phase, while each local antigen remains independently targetable.
records.summary_rna: ONT links both alleles in 21 UMIs; Illumina links neither

rna_evidence.counts_text: 21 ALT/ALT UMI groups; 3 exact full-interval Q20 reads; 0 linked Illumina reads

records.title: ZNF436 p.Ser207Cys long-read context
records.dna_only: The SNV predicts p.Ser207Cys but says nothing about how much contiguous expressed sequence is available for antigen-window enumeration.
records.decision_reason: ONT reconstructs 49 aa versus 30 aa with Illumina assembly and 29 aa without it, expanding the candidate pool and yielding a selected construct.
records.interpretation: The mutation identity is unchanged; long reads expand the defensible flanking sequence and therefore the set of junction-overlapping long peptides Vaxrank can consider.
records.limitation: Three ALT UMI groups support the ONT context; platform-dependent context length is shown as evidence, not interpreted as differential abundance.
records.summary_rna: ONT 49 aa; Illumina assembly 30 aa; Illumina unassembled 29 aa

rna_evidence.counts_text: ONT 3 ALT UMI groups; ILMN 8 ALT observations / 7 supporting templates
